now.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
now.text: In season 5, Wolverine slips into Genosha with Cyclops and Jean to tell Magneto that Xavier is dying.

proposed.text: In season 5, Wolverine, Cyclops and Jean break into Magneto's fortress on Genosha to stop his uprising, until Magneto learns that Xavier is dying.

changes.evidence: Graduation Day (season 5 finale): after Gyrich's attack puts Xavier in a coma and Genosha's mutants rally to Magneto, the X-Men decide they must attack Magneto directly on Genosha; Cyclops, Jean and Wolverine go, are shot down, break into his fortress and fight him, and he stops when he discovers Xavier's broadcast was fake and Xavier is dying. They went to stop Magneto, not to tell him Xavier was dying.

owner_calls.question: Step 0 status is Off-world, but What If...? episode 2 ends with Yondu on Earth: he urges T'Challa to go home, and the Ravagers spend time with the Wakandan royals in Wakanda. Keep Off-world (a space-based Ravager) or change to Active?
owner_calls.evidence: Episode 2 synopsis: 'Udonta encourages him to return to Wakanda and reunite with his biological family. As the Ravagers and the Wakandan royals share time together...'
